headline: Mooring Quiets While Weathered Expanse Trades Blows
war_summary: Since the evening wire the Weathered Expanse adds fresh copy with three changes in two hours and thirty-nine in the day around Crow's Nest, Frostmarch and Wightwalk, latest at 22:41, holdings now five Warden to four Colonial with day losses near ten thousand seven hundred Colonial and eleven thousand four hundred Warden and short rates cooling. Mooring County falls silent in the last two hours after thirty-seven day changes around Gravekeeper's Holdfast, The Cut and Wiccwalk, latest at 21:31, now eleven Warden to one Colonial with day losses near ten thousand a side and rates cooling. Palantine Berm counts six day changes at Leiri Hermanni, latest at 22:10, standing six Warden to one Colonial. Stlican Shelf rests since 19:55 with eleven day changes, still three Warden to six Colonial. New action comes from Linn Mercy with three changes at Rotdust, latest at 23:10, still eleven Colonial, while Nevish Line shows three changes at Grief Mother, latest at 21:55. Farranac Coast and Stonecradle remain quiet, and Callahans Passage records heavy losses without a flip.
